title: NightWatch Credential Injection Lease
description: Short-lived, run-scoped credential injection lease (C08, §5.10). Values never persist; only the lease metadata exists here. RUNTIME SEMANTIC: expired leases are REJECTED by default, never auto-extended (§22.5.4).
x-nightwatch-security: No value fields allowed under any circumstances (§13.1).
x-nightwatch-runtime-semantics: Expired leases are rejected, not auto-extended.

credential_reference_name.description: Credential variable NAME being injected (never the value).

run_id.description: Run the lease is scoped to.
